title: Architectural admission attestation
description: Machine-checkable record that a named object cleared a named, machine-checkable ARCHITECTURAL predicate at a stated commit. It is NOT a review, NOT a grade, NOT a promotion and NOT an independence credit. Admission says the repository's own structural gates accepted the object; it says nothing whatever about whether the mathematics is correct. Every admitted object is still waiting on something, and `awaiting` is where that is written down. Enforced by tools/attestations_check.py.

attestation_id.description: Unique in attestations/records/ and equal to the filename stem.

attested_utc.description: When the predicate was evaluated. Age never converts a REFUSED into an ADMITTED, and never converts an ADMITTED into anything further.

object_id.description: Exact object identity: repository path plus commit, Drive file id, or carrier id plus member path. Not a title, not a folder.

predicate_id.description: Identifier of the architectural predicate evaluated, e.g. ARCH-ADMISSION-V1.

predicate_statement.description: What passing this predicate means, stated so a reader can tell what it does not mean.

predicate_source.description: Where the predicate is defined: the checker paths, the schema, or the governance document.

checks.description: Every command actually run, with its real exit code. A single non-zero exit code forbids ADMITTED.

outcome.description: ADMITTED: the structural gates accepted the object. REFUSED: they did not. There is no third value, and no partial credit.

awaiting.description: What the object is still waiting on after this attestation. Required to be non-empty: architectural admission never finishes anything, so an attestation that claimed nothing remained would be false by construction.

claim_grade_after.description: The grade of every claim after this record exists. Always UNCHANGED. An attestation cannot raise, lower or create a grade.

gate_status_after.description: The state of every gate, premise and obligation after this record exists. Always UNCHANGED.

independence_credit.description: Always zero. An attestation is not a review and cannot carry organizational independence.

does_not_establish.description: What this attestation does NOT establish, specific to this object. Boilerplate shared with another record is rejected.

superseded_by.description: The attestation that re-ran the gates against this object's current bytes. An attestation speaks only for the commit it names, so when the object changes the record does not become false, it becomes historical. Setting this marks it as such and exempts it from the current-bytes check; the named successor must exist in the same directory.
